snippet.title: Time to Crate - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
"Time to Crate" is an incremental platformer/survivors-like/arcade/dating sim/jrpg love story. You're a circular saw. There are crates. Destroy them. Jump. Bump. Ground pound. Get the money. Buy upgrades. Become stronger. Ridiculously stronger. Do it again. And again. And again. Time. To. Crate.

Wishlist "Time to Crate" on Steam!
